financial_review.finding: Chosen holding horizon does not equal the target
financial_review.evidence: Final explanation uses approximately63trading days. The exact exchange-calendar target is60close-to-close increments. Code did compute60as sensitivity, alongside63/65, but did not select it as the declared main horizon.
OLS and log-levelAR1fit the nineFY2017-2025observations. Neither is compared at held-out forecast origins against persistence/another baseline.

financial_review.finding: Parameter uncertainty omitted from small-sample forecasts
financial_review.evidence: OLS resamples a single fitted residual at the2027trend; AR1recursively draws two residuals using fixed coefficients estimated from eight transitions. Neither resamples/propagates fitted parameter uncertainty or tests coverage.

financial_review.finding: Overlapping window bootstrap understates dependence for the mean
financial_review.evidence: Code samples overlapping60/63/65day excess returns as if independent observations when bootstrapping mean excess returns. Neighboring windows share almost all daily observations. Narrow mean confidence intervals are not future-return predictive intervals.
financial_review.final_impact: Issued stock quantiles use the historical return distribution, not these narrow mean confidence limits; preserve this distinction.

financial_review.finding: Current TTM is not incorporated into the fitted annual model
financial_review.evidence: Earlier program printed2026Q1TTM2.213556Bbefore later KeyError2016. Successful model fits only annualFY2017-2025. Final explanation says annual data plus Q12026TTMwas used; TTMwas observed but no update or model weight incorporates it in the fitted feature/target series.
